# AIS-MOD-01

**Is every model version pinned, with a documented route to change it?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | MOD: Model and value chain |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.ai.model.version_pinned`, `elements.ai.model.version` |

## Why it matters

An unpinned model changes behaviour without a release; the evals that justified the design no longer apply.

## Rule

Every ai facet has model.version_pinned true and model.version set. Where model.hosting is managed-platform and the platform does not let the team pin the model, a decision affecting the element that accepts the platform-managed model, with gating evals rerun on any platform model change as its condition, meets this criterion instead.

## Sources

- NIST AI 600-1, Generative AI Profile (2024) (`nist-600-1`)
- OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026, LLM04 Supply Chain (`owasp-llm04`)
